title: Dyadic Analysis Filter Bank
text: 将信号分解为带宽更小且采样率更低的子带，或计算离散小波变换 (DWT)，输入 1 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Filter} 指定子带分解中使用的滤波器类型；{Filter order [synthesis / analysis]} 指定双正交滤波器的分析和合成滤波器阶数、{Wavelet order} 指定正交 wavelet 的阶数、{Lowpass FIR filter coefficients}、{Highpass FIR filter coefficients}、{Number of levels} 指定分析、{Tree structure} 指定滤波器组的结构、{Output} 指定单端口或多端口 Multiple，按实例取值。

ports.name: Input 1
ports.summary: 数据输入 column vector | matrix

ports.name: Output 1
ports.summary: 二进子带分解输出 column vector | matrix

params.name: Filter
params.values: 子带分解中使用的滤波器类型 User-defined (default) | Haar | Daubechies | Symlets | Coiflets | Biorthogonal | Reverse Biorthogonal | Discrete Meyer

params.name: Wavelet order
params.values: 正交 wavelet 的阶数 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Lowpass FIR filter coefficients
params.values: Lowpass FIR filter coefficients [0.0352 -0.0854 -0.1350 0.4599 0.8069 0.3327] (default) | row vector

params.name: Highpass FIR filter coefficients
params.values: Highpass FIR filter coefficients [-0.3327 0.8069 -0.4599 -0.1350 0.0854 0.0352] (default) | row vector

params.name: Number of levels
params.values: 分析（分解）中使用的滤波器组级数 2 (default) | integer greater than or equal to 1

params.name: Tree structure
params.values: 滤波器组的结构 Asymmetric (default) | Symmetric

params.name: Output
params.values: 单端口或多端口 Multiple ports (default) | Single port
